editorial:
Imagine you are on a road trip with your partner, looking for a cozy place to stay. You find a rental that looks perfect online, and the host seems super friendly. That is exactly where you start in this story. You follow two travel vloggers who just want a great spot to film their content. But as soon as they arrive, you realize the host is a little too obsessed with his five-star rating. The vibe starts off feeling like a normal vacation, but it quickly turns into a nightmare as the host's need for approval becomes a dangerous obsession. You will feel that creeping tension as you realize these guests are not just visitors, but prizes for a crazy man.

The acting is great, especially the guy playing the host who manages to be creepy and polite at the same time. While some parts of the plot move a bit slow, the twists keep you guessing until the end. It is a perfect pick if you have ever stayed in an Airbnb and wondered if the owner was watching you.
endingExplained: You find out the host has been kidnapping guests to force them to give him perfect reviews. In the final act, the vloggers fight for their lives to escape his traps. The host eventually goes too far, and after a tense struggle, the couple manages to outsmart him. They finally get away, but the movie leaves you feeling uneasy about trusting strangers online, showing that some people will do anything for a bit of internet fame.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about creepy hosts and survival games.
